prayer for vocations: we pray for the men called to priesthood. like jesus in today's
gospel, may they never turn away from the poor, the hungry, the most vulnerable, or those in
need, but always reflect the love of christ for them as they nourish and strengthen them with
the word of god. we pray to the lord.
“it is to the glory of my father that you should bear much fruit and then you will be my
disciples.” are you being called to love the lord and his people as a priest, sister or brother?
